why: phase-492 W4: the callback type of `c:executor_add_subscription_raw_validated` -- `void (*)(const uint8_t *data, size_t len, int64_t gap, bool duplicate, int8_t crc_valid, void *context)`. The byte tier of `c:subscription_raw_callback_t` plus the E2E integrity scalars; rclc has no integrity check and so no such type. Distinct name by RFC-0089 rule 2: it is not rclc's `rclc_subscription_callback_t` contract.
